title: 熱力学Ⅰ
subtitle: Thermodynamics I
keywords: Temperature and heat 2.Thermal equilibrium 3.Mixed gas 4.Ideal gas 5.The first law of thermodynamics
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn basic knowledge of the irreversibility in the nature world (2) Learn how to convert energy and obtain work from heat (3) Acquire design skills for energy conversion in mechanical engineering
advice: This is a basic course in thermodynamics. We will cover the following topics: 1. Definitions of heat, temperature and systems 2. Thermal equilibrium and the zeroth law of thermodynamics 3. Thermal properties of mixed gases 4. Equation of state of ideal gases 5. The first law of thermodynamics Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and formulas. Students are expected to solve exercises independently. Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of quizzes, tests, and reports may change as the class progresses. Students should not be absent from class, as they may not receive the handouts. Detailed schedules and content of the course are explained in the first class.
books: JSME Textbook Series Thermodynamics ISBN:4-88898-104-3 C3353
requiredKnowledge: Have sufficient skill in mathematics (especially differential and integral calculations). Know how to use a calculator.
